description: Source code defining tree ensemble models (Random Forest and Gradient Boosted Trees) in Spark MLlib, including model classes, saving/loading mechanisms, and prediction methods.

classes.name: RandomForestModel
classes.description: Represents a random forest ensemble model with save/load capabilities.

classes.name: GradientBoostedTreesModel
classes.description: Represents a gradient boosted trees ensemble model with evaluation methods.

classes.name: TreeEnsembleModel
classes.description: Abstract class for tree ensemble models, providing prediction and utility methods.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the model to a specified path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a model from a specified path.

methods.name: evaluateEachIteration
methods.description: Computes error/loss for each iteration of gradient boosting.

methods.name: computeInitialPredictionAndError
methods.description: Computes initial predictions and errors for training data.

methods.name: updatePredictionError
methods.description: Updates prediction and error RDDs after adding a new tree.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts output for a single data point or RDD of data points.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a summary string of the model.

methods.name: toDebugString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the full model.
